scripts.build: npm run build -w @the-system/web && npm run build -w @the-system/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/engine && tsc -p apps/server && tsc -p apps/web && tsc -p apps/desktop && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run banned && npm run test
scripts.e2e: npm run build && playwright test --project=e2e && playwright test --project=latency
scripts.desktop:smoke: npm run build && npm run build -w @the-system/desktop && npm run smoke -w @the-system/desktop
